_description: Response body returned by POST /api/reviews — the result of a sentiment classification operation. Extends ReviewSampleResponse with two additional fields: confidenceScore and uncertain.

_notes.confidenceScore: The Naive Bayes model's probability score for the winning label. Between 0.0 and 1.0. A score below the configured uncertaintyThreshold (default 0.65) triggers Claude oracle consultation.
_notes.uncertain: True when confidenceScore was below the uncertaintyThreshold and the Claude AI oracle was consulted. The label in this case comes from Claude, not the model directly.
_notes.labelSource: SEED when the model was confident (uncertain=false). CLAUDE when the oracle was consulted (uncertain=true).

_variant_confident_positive._comment: Model classified confidently as POSITIVE — no oracle consultation. labelSource is SEED.
_variant_confident_positive.reviewText: An absolute masterpiece. The performances were outstanding and the storyline kept me gripped from start to finish.
_variant_confident_positive.label: POSITIVE

_variant_confident_negative._comment: Model classified confidently as NEGATIVE — no oracle consultation. labelSource is SEED.
_variant_confident_negative.reviewText: Dreadful from beginning to end. I cannot believe this film received any praise whatsoever.
_variant_confident_negative.label: NEGATIVE

_variant_uncertain_oracle_consulted._comment: Model was uncertain (score below threshold). Claude oracle was consulted. labelSource is CLAUDE.
_variant_uncertain_oracle_consulted.reviewText: It was... fine I suppose. Not terrible, but hardly the masterpiece the critics claimed.
_variant_uncertain_oracle_consulted.label: NEGATIVE
